result.summary: Built c01 "refactor!: retire the Python driver stack (hsim, tools/, tests/hsim)" on review/andesim-series (base 16a8c53). Deleted: ./hsim, tools/hsim_shm.py, tools/orchestrator/ (incl. tests+examples), tests/hsim/ (12 scripts), specs/hybrid-sim-gem5-switch-parity.md, hybrid_plan.md, driver_ROADMAP.md, and the two orchestrator-backed demos (tests/demos/demo_archive_replay.sh, demo_simpoint_loop.sh). tools/simpoint gitlink kept for c03. Scrubbed every live reference: scripts/run_e2e.sh (DEMO_TESTS T6/T7 dropped, comments), tests/fixtures/demo.sh (DEMOS T6/T7 dropped), 3 tests/plugin comment headers, 2 demo comment headers, qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c + tests/fixtures/rt_c_no_trigger_exit.c comments, README quickstart (setup.sh/run_e2e flow), CLAUDE.md (hsim primary path + tests/hsim paragraph removed), ROADMAP.md (retirement NOTE added, deleted-file references removed), docs/USER_GUIDE.md (sections 0.5, 2.5, 2.6, 4.6, 4.6.5, 4.7 removed; M-range and env-var table fixed), docs/switching_modes_tutorial.md (M6/M7 rows, sections 7-8 removed, tail renumbered 7-10, checklist/tally now T1..T5), docs/TODO.md (F-T3.1 trimmed to M3-M5, hybrid_plan.md pointers reworded, orchestrator->harness), docs/HYBRID_OVERVIEW.md and docs/v_csr_plan.md word scrubs. 58 files changed, +78/-7490. Worktree clean; exactly one new commit.
result.validation_notes: Gate 1: grep -rn 'hsim|orchestrator' over *.sh/*.py/Makefile (excl .git) returns zero hits. Gate 2: bash -n passes on every tracked .sh file (incl. tests/e2e.sh). Extra: gcc -fsyntax-only on qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c against the final tree's vendored qemu-plugin.h passes (make -C qemu_plugin not runnable at this stage: QEMU submodule unpopulated; vendored header lands at c04 per spec). Full-tree grep confirms no remaining live references to hsim/HSIM_MMAP_DIR/tools/orchestrator/hybrid_plan.md/driver_ROADMAP.md/specs/ outside ROADMAP.md's explicitly-marked historical feature records.
deviations: Deleted tests/demos/demo_archive_replay.sh and demo_simpoint_loop.sh at c01 instead of c03: both invoke python3 -m orchestrator.main / orchestrator.checkpoint deleted in this commit; c01's validate rule requires referencing files to die with the reference. c03 still deletes the remaining tests/demos/.
tests/hsim contained 12 scripts at base (expected_delta says 'all 10', which counts the old-tip set); all 12 deleted.

ROADMAP.md kept (not deleted) with a retirement NOTE; its remaining 'orchestrator'/'tools/orchestrator' mentions are past-tense as-built records inside F2-F12 entries, explicitly framed as historical by the new note. Full rewrite lands at c36 per spec.

Doc scrubs went beyond strict deletions where consistency required it: USER_GUIDE lost sections 0.5/2.5/2.6/4.6/4.6.5/4.7 plus M-range fixes; switching_modes_tutorial lost M6/M7 quick-map rows and sections 7-8 with tail sections renumbered 9-12 -> 7-10; TODO.md/HYBRID_OVERVIEW/v_csr_plan got word-level orchestrator->harness scrubs and hybrid_plan.md pointer rewording.

docs/simpoint_transport_comparison.md left untouched: its only match is the generic design-option label 'GDB-as-orchestrator' (not the Python package), and the file itself dies at c03 with the simpoint pipeline.

make -C qemu_plugin replaced by a syntax-only compile check borrowing the final tree's vendored qemu-plugin.h (same recipe the spec prescribes for c02), since the base-era plugin build requires the unpopulated QEMU submodule.
